memory_candidates: The diamond-witness dual of a box-witness's 'combine multiple boxed-disjuncts, bridge via a Fischer-Servi axiom' construction can need a DIFFERENT axiom on each side: box_witness (Kb/Kd/Idb) needs Idb because box distributes INTO disjunctions 'for free' via K + necessitated OrI, but the box-of-disjuncts must still be BRIDGED via the box-side Fischer-Servi axiom; diamond_witness (Kb/Kd/Cd/dbot) needs Cd because diamond distributing OUT of disjunctions is the HARD direction (not valid from K-diamond alone), and needs an extra base-case axiom (dbot: diamond-bot -> bot) for the length-zero disjunction case, exactly where the classical reference's LEM-based cexpl/fallible-world case split would otherwise be needed. This means dbot is not merely an IK-only frame condition (as report 03 first classified it under the Nd label) -- it is core-framework-load-bearing for the diamond witness whenever the canonical worlds are consistency-baked (no fallible-world escape hatch).
